# Independent precise-rung comparison: launch evidence

The original R01 baseline call stopped after its MCP response without a usable trace; its external request count is unknown, and it remains unscored. The independent [R03–R06 preregistration](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-prereg-v1.json) and [key-free runner input](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-input-v1.json) were committed at `70efad8f`. They fix eight paired calls, no retries or model inference, a 12-call outer ceiling, 24 ESearch-rung ceiling, and blind assessment before unblinding. The runner does not load the scoring key.

The retained harness checks exact source commits and MCP tree hashes, current engine source and helper hashes, clean committed authorization, a direct lifecycle parent, distinct loopback listeners/caches, same-process trace and source identity, and one underlying attempt on an injected HTTP 503. Missing traces leave external request counts `unknown`; aggregate ESearch counts are explicitly `verified_trace_only`. A usable new path gets a terminal preflight record, and interruption asks the runner to write `STOPPED` before process cleanup. Two Luna 6 xhigh implementation workers and a fresh-context reviewer found and closed the earlier duplicate-validation, virtualenv, retry-proof, interruption, preflight-record, runtime-support, and commit-race gaps. The initial virtualenv failure remains in the [first offline receipt](novelty-precise-rung-offline-launch-2026-09-25.json).

The first [committed launch amendment](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-protocol-amendment-2026-09-25.json) pinned a live baseline/candidate pair at `46f8a6a9`, and the driver correctly waited for that commit. The runner then rejected a relative parent script path at preflight, before MCP initialization. Its [terminal no-call record](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-preflight-stopped-2026-09-25.json), [lifecycle receipt](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-lifecycle-2026-09-25.json), and [redacted diagnostic](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-lifecycle-2026-09-25-runner-stderr.log) retain the failure. The original fixed result path was freed by moving the zero-call record to this distinct retained filename; there was no public PubMed call, model inference, scoring, or retry. The driver now rejects relative script invocation before server startup.

The [absolute-path dry launch](novelty-precise-rung-offline-launch-v5-2026-09-25.json) ran the current driver. Its [baseline](novelty-precise-rung-offline-launch-v5-2026-09-25-baseline-launch.json) and [candidate](novelty-precise-rung-offline-launch-v5-2026-09-25-candidate-launch.json) each served on loopback, wrote the expected same-PID trace, and proved one injected 503 attempt with no external traffic. The old amendment did not match these receipts, so no runner started; the driver removed both listeners and worktrees.

A second live pair was pinned in committed amendment `649d1238`. The [lifecycle receipt](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-lifecycle-v2-2026-09-25.json) shows the runner exited 2 and both child processes and worktrees were removed. Its [diagnostic](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-lifecycle-v2-2026-09-25-runner-stderr.log) records `KeyError: 'runner_input_sha256'`: `_preflight` omitted that and `source_prereg_sha256` from the hash values handed to `main`. The failure occurred during report construction, before MCP client initialization, so it made no PubMed or model call. An offline test reproduced this exact initialization failure; the runner now forwards both hashes. A second red-first test found that a report-construction error left only an empty reserved file, and another found that a reservation collision could rewrite somebody else's JSON result. The runner now retains a zero-call `STOPPED` record only for its own fully reserved result, and leaves pre-existing results untouched. The 55 runner/driver and seven launcher offline tests pass; this is harness readiness, not a completed scientific comparison.

The current amendment pins a stopped process pair and cannot authorize another run. The next launch requires a fresh pair, inspected receipts and parent command, and a newly committed amendment with those exact hashes. An incomplete call stays open and unscored; this document does not authorize substituting a case or repeating a public call.

The final pinned pair at `6696136b` completed the separately preregistered eight-call schedule. The [lifecycle receipt](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-lifecycle-v3-2026-09-25.json) reports runner exit 0, `COMPLETED`, and removal of both listeners, child processes and temporary worktrees. The [raw run](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-run-2026-09-25.json) retains all eight ordered responses and matching attempted-rung/selected/fetched/final PMID lineage: 20 trace-verified ESearch rungs, 72 submitted metadata IDs, zero retries, model calls or paid calls. The configured no-retry and forced-503 evidence supports one attempt per Entrez method invocation. The [derived accounting in the score](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-score-2026-09-25.json) is 20 ESearch plus 72 EFetch plus 72 ELink method invocations; the exact underlying HTTP request count was not wire-observed and remains `unknown` in every raw call.

The [shuffled blind packet](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-blind-2026-09-25.json) and [query-only case context](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-case-context-2026-09-25.json) were finalized and hash-linked to the raw run. A first review inadvertently exposed the preregistration's scoring key and was not used to lock labels. A separate Luna 6 xhigh reviewer read only those two blinded files; its [24 labels](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-blind-labels-2026-09-25.json) were committed at `2d9b5ced` before PMID unblinding. No abstract was insufficient to judge. The [frozen score](novelty-precise-rung-01b2b-independent-score-2026-09-25.json) records positive-target recall@3 of 0 baseline versus 1 candidate, no lost positive or control anchor, zero positive-target cross-hits in either control, and no per-request unrelatedness increase. This clears the narrow exploratory gates on four paired queries. Its preregistration explicitly withholds product-adoption authority; the isolated retrieval candidate remains undeployed pending independent confirmation or a separately justified final disposition.
